title: Finite and Symmetric Multiple $T$-Values
summary: The multiple $T$-values (MTVs), first studied by Kaneko and Tsumura, are a variation of the multiple zeta values (MZVs) with restricted product structure. Motivated by a deep conjecture of Kaneko and Zagier relating finite MZVs and symmetric MZVs, which was extended to Euler sums by Zhao, we study finite and symmetric multiple $T$-values. In particular, we show that finite MTVs satisfy Hoffman-type duality relations at low height, confirming several conjectures of the second author and discovering new families of identities.
